_evidence_note: Reddit thread bodies were NOT obtainable: reddit.com blocks both the WebSearch user agent and Firecrawl. Findings below come from (a) Reddit/forum search-result TITLES, which evidence the questions homeowners ask, and (b) the 12 real customer reviews scraped from the client's own site, which are local primary voice. Treated as directional, not as a read of thread comments.

pain_points.claim: Homeowners fear storm-chaser outfits that appear after weather events, push an insurance claim, and disappear.
pain_points.evidence: Recurring thread titles: 'What is the risk in using a stormchasing roofing company?', 'Are Storm Damage Experts people a scam?', 'Is this roofer trying to rope me into an insurance scam?'

pain_points.claim: Fear of paying up front and being left with unfinished or shoddy work.
pain_points.evidence: Reviewers repeatedly single out that Gilroy took no payment until they were satisfied — praised as unusual.

pain_points.claim: Contractors who don't show when promised, or whose timeline slips.
pain_points.evidence: Multiple reviews explicitly praise showing up early and hitting the stated date — implying the opposite is the norm locally.

pain_points.claim: Debris and nails left behind after the job.
pain_points.evidence: Cleanup is the single most-mentioned positive across the review corpus — 'you would never know roofing just occurred'.

pain_points.claim: Being left to fight the insurance company alone.
pain_points.evidence: A reviewer notes Ed 'personally handled an issue with my insurance company and had it resolved without me having to contact them'.

what_customers_value: A quote that is honored exactly — 'charged me exactly what he quoted'
Speed: full tear-off and replacement finished in one to one-and-a-half days
Site left spotless, no nails or debris
A named, reachable owner who answers calls and texts
Deep local roots and generational continuity
Not paying until the work is done and accepted
business_differentiators: Family owned in the Wyoming Valley since 1972 — the structural opposite of a storm-chaser
No payment until the project is 100% complete
Owens Corning Platinum Preferred with a 50-year material and labor warranty
Handles insurance claims on the homeowner's behalf
Second-generation owner, Ed Gilroy Jr., personally on estimates

copy_angles.why: Directly answers the top anxiety surfaced in search titles. Their 54 years is the proof, not a slogan.

copy_angles.angle: You don't pay until it's done
copy_angles.why: Their own strongest, most repeated differentiator and the one reviewers single out. Ownable, concrete, verifiable.

copy_angles.angle: We leave it like we were never here
copy_angles.why: Cleanup is the most-praised item across the entire review corpus.

copy_angles.angle: We deal with your insurer, you don't
copy_angles.why: Turns the scariest part of a storm claim into a service they perform.

copy_angles.angle: Done in a day and a half
copy_angles.why: Repeated independently by several reviewers; concrete and checkable.

recommended_hero.headline: You Don't Pay Until It's Done
recommended_hero.support: Third-generation Wilkes-Barre roofers. We quote it, we do it, we clean up after ourselves — and we don't take a dollar until you're satisfied.
